practiceAccompaniment.candidateLabel: 应用自动轻伴奏候选；非实体和弦目标
practiceAccompaniment.sourceScope: Same selected 山山 edition and exact 64-bar vocal route
practiceAccompaniment.choice: One low root on the first beat of each editorial four-bar block, 16 attacks over 192 beats. This is an editorial sparse subset, not a source bass rhythm or phrase-mark claim.
practiceAccompaniment.bassRegisterDecision: Root octave chosen at the lowest available F3–E6 natural key. No source bass octave exists in the adopted symbol-only evidence; this is voicing, not individual folding of a literal bass line.
practiceAccompaniment.writtenDurationDecision: 0.75 beat is an editorial pluck event length, not source note duration or PCM gating.
practiceAccompaniment.sourceChordQualities: Preserve C, G, Am, Em, Fmaj7, Dm7 and A7 in private evidence; root-only selected subset does not reproduce full chords. A7 C# is omitted along with all unselected A7 attacks, never naturalized.
practiceAccompaniment.restPolicy: All 20 literal vocal rests get silent app-support policy by conservative editorial omission. No held-support exceptions or all-layer source-silence claims.
practiceAccompaniment.volumeDecision: 0.28 support volume and 0.30 velocity remain the frozen provisional arrangement settings. Numerical full-graph measurements do not establish subjective quietness or harmonic acceptance.
limits: Independent symbol/crop reading is complete within the disclosed inherited route numbering; it is not a second independent source edition.
Actual full-graph numerical rendering is complete; subjective A/B, reference listening, physical kalimba and live-browser scheduler/lifecycle acceptance are separate gates.
Natural backing tails measurably enter six vocal rests and later chord intervals at 1× and 1.4×; finite numerical checks do not establish inaudibility or strict silence.
No cadence root is added at beat189; terminal C4 melody and final [191,192) vocal rest are unchanged.
Source images, full private maps and raw browser diagnostics stay outside this package; public-distribution rights remain unestablished.

sourceSymbolReview.tempoDecision: 84 BPM is the retained editorial practice tempo; no numeric tempo is printed. The 0.9 suggestion is separate from the live selected multiplier.
sourceSymbolReview.measureNumbering: Editorially counted from the omitted guitar introduction, not printed source labels.
sourceSymbolReview.independentPixelReading: Two readers agree on all 51 symbols and change positions in this one edition. The second reader freshly reviewed eight crops and four repeat/ending glyph locations; the editorial full-route measure count was inherited from the preceding full-page vocal review, not independently recounted.

restAndEnding.silentPolicyMeaning: No app-support onset or written span in these vocal rests. Neither source guitar silence nor strict PCM/effects silence is asserted.

historicalSibling.decision: Preserve the old 78-note source record and its original automatic backing byte-for-byte; never borrow that backing for the 183-note melody. The old sibling has no practiceAccompaniment field.

practiceAccompaniment.acousticTailBoundary: Written 0.75-beat spans are not PCM cutoffs. Full original sample buffers and the 0.55-second convolution, filter and compressor produce natural tails. At configured 84 BPM with 1× and 1.4×, six vocal-rest windows and all 16 next-chord-boundary windows contain measured backing-only residuals; at 0.55× these windows are zero in this finite render. No sample trimming, strict acoustic silence, perceived loudness or musical acceptance is claimed.

numericalAudioReview.rmsRatioMeaning: Separate backing-only / mixed full-duration RMS; not a perceived-loudness percentage or an isolated contribution through the nonlinear shared compressor.

practiceAccompaniment.importBoundary: Raw built-in practiceAccompaniment is rejected by the external importer, not silently dropped. A deliberately prepared external V2 autoAccompaniment representation preserves all 183 targets, 16 roots, settings, 20 vocal-rest policies and extent 192.

suitability.reason: Frozen 183-note single melody plus 16 source-symbol-derived app roots at disclosed editorial registers, spacing, duration and gain. Numerical feasibility is distinct from listening, harmonic and physical acceptance.
reviewRequired: Subjective A/B at the actual selected practice speeds, reference listening and physical kalimba remain pending.
Public-distribution rights remain unestablished; this is a local preview.

unsupported: App-only sparse roots derive from selected printed chord symbols; no literal guitar bass, full voicing, strumming or picking pattern is transcribed.
All original 183 single-melody targets remain unchanged; support is optional and default-off.
Twenty vocal rests have no new support onset or written overlap; natural full-sample/effects tails are preserved.
The original V1 and historical V2 source payloads remain untouched, including their earlier review-stage wording.
